items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio - 2,297 stars today, still the page's top repo
items.summary:
voicestudio does voice cloning, dubbing, dictation and audiobooks locally in 646 languages, with no api key and no cloud round-trip.
2,297 stars in 24 hours took it to 89,536, and the repo was still being pushed to this morning.

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark - 2,244 stars for an anti-slop design skill
items.summary:
hallmark hands claude code, cursor and codex concrete css rules so pages stop looking like default ai output.
2,244 stars today held second place on 36,702 total, a big following for a repo that is mostly a skill file.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable - 1,506 stars for a design language agents can load
items.summary:
impeccable packages a shared design vocabulary an agent reads instead of guessing at taste.
it slipped from 1,551 stars yesterday to 1,506 today and sits on 89,355 total, with the repo pushed again at 03:11 utc.

items.title: TauricResearch/TradingAgents - 1,395 stars for a multi-agent trading desk
items.summary:
tradingagents puts a research desk of llm agents around a trade, with bull and bear analysts arguing before anything is bought.
1,395 stars today took it to 116,322, the biggest finance repo on the page and one built for people who already trade.

items.title: makecindy/cindy - 1,296 stars for an agent that claims to work out of the box
items.summary:
cindy is pitched at people who do not want to spend an evening wiring tools into an agent first.
1,296 stars today took it to 6,670, so nearly all of its audience has found it in the last few days.

items.title: JetBrains/thinkrail - 1,173 stars as a big vendor ships an agentic ide
items.summary:
thinkrail is an open-source, lightweight ide that customises itself around how you work and runs an agent inside the editor.
1,173 stars today took it to 3,078, with 224 open issues showing how fast it is being built.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC - 896 stars for an agent-harness tuning layer
items.summary:
ECC bundles skills, instinct files, memory, security checks and research habits into one optimisation layer for claude code, codex, opencode and cursor.
896 stars today on 289,960 total, the largest star base on the page and the one that has been around longest.

items.title: pollen-robotics/microduck - the biped duck keeps its place
items.summary:
microduck is a desk-sized two-legged robot duck, and the repo carries the control code that makes it walk. it is written in rust.
843 stars today and 12,488 total, holding a spot on the page for a second day.

items.title: jordan bombs targets in syria and damascus shuts the border
items.summary:
jordanian jets hit what the army called militant hideouts in daraa and suweyda overnight, retaliation for friday's church attack in karak that killed nine.
syria says at least seven people died, including three children, that it was not told in advance, and it has closed the nasib crossing.
items.change: jordan's first strikes inside syria since the attack, and the only passenger crossing between the two countries is now shut.

items.title: israelis vote today in an election the polls call a coin flip
items.summary:
israelis vote today, with likud and eisenkot's yashar level in the final surveys and about 70,000 people expected to fly home to cast a ballot.
netanyahu closed with an ai image of a nuclear strike on tel aviv and trump's endorsement, while west bank crossings are shut for the day.
items.change: it is voting day: the campaign is over, the crossings are closed and the count starts tonight.

items.title: report: netanyahu pushed the idf to act on iran before the vote
items.summary:
channel 12 says netanyahu gave the military a directive on iran and that chief of staff eyal zamir asked to see it in writing.
netanyahu and the defence ministry deny any plan to strike, and the guardian reports his coalition is narrowly trailing.
items.change: the story moved from a reported rift between the two men to a specific directive that zamir wanted in writing.

items.title: the mecca pact delegation leaves tehran with a promise to keep talking
items.summary:
khalid bin salman, asim munir and ibrahim kalin met pezeshkian and rezaei, and both sides said they would keep talking about regional security.
iran says washington is not serious, and oman's foreign minister used the same day to propose a gulf-iran security pact with no us at its centre.
items.change: the visit ended with an agreement to keep talking rather than a deal, and oman publicly broke ranks on the us role.

items.title: houthis claim strikes on riyadh airport and saudi oil pumping stations
items.summary:
the group said it fired missiles at the capital's airport and sent drones at oil pumping stations on monday, and riyadh has not confirmed either hit.
crude still settled lower as traders bet the tehran talks can hold, with prices up about 12% this month.
items.change: the claimed targets widened from the border and the south to riyadh airport and oil infrastructure.

items.title: a vessel is on fire off iraq's coast and nobody has confirmed why
items.summary:
ukmto reported a ship ablaze 63 nautical miles south-east of al-faw late on monday, the latest in a run of incidents around hormuz.
no side has confirmed the cause, and the fire is being treated as a security risk to shipping in the gulf.
items.change: a new incident in the gulf overnight, with the cause still unconfirmed.

items.title: eleven killed in gaza in 24 hours, including four in a tent camp
items.summary:
gaza's civil defence says 11 people were killed and 50 wounded in the past day, with the deadliest strike on a camp for displaced people in al-mawasi.
a drone hit on a tent in gaza city's remal neighbourhood killed one more, according to wafa.
items.change: the 24-hour toll was revised up to 11 dead and 50 wounded, with four killed in a single camp strike.

items.title: the s&p closes 0.7% higher as chips and tesla lead
items.summary:
the s&p 500 added 0.70% to 7,676.77 and the nasdaq 0.83% to 26,169.38, with tesla up more than 5% and nvidia 2%.
the dow rose 146 points, and the vix fell 5.5% to 18.39 as the ai trade got a lift from anthropic's filing.

items.title: futures are flat before a heavy earnings day and the fed
items.summary:
s&p futures were marginally lower and nasdaq-100 futures up 0.1% early on tuesday, a flat start after monday's rally.
the fomc begins its two-day meeting today, with the decision and the vote split due on wednesday.

items.title: oil slips as the tehran talks keep the war premium in check
items.summary:
brent settled at $115.81, down 91 cents, and wti at $101.76, down $1.51, as saudi and iranian officials met in tehran.
wti was near $100.80 early on tuesday, and the us strategic reserve is at its lowest since 1982 with crude still up about 12% this month.

items.title: anthropic's ipo filing lands, and the whole ai trade is now on trial
items.summary:
the s-1 shows $16.29bn of revenue in the six months to june against an $80.7bn loss, with goldman sachs and morgan stanley leading.
cnbc reports some $77bn of notes can be issued to amazon, broadcom and google, and the listing could be the largest ipo on record.

items.title: microsoft offers buyouts to 60,000 staff to help pay for ai
items.summary:
the offer covers us, canada, india and uk employees at level 70 and below, about 27% of its 223,000 workforce.
staff decide by early december and leavers go on 31 december, the clearest sign yet that ai capex is being paid for with headcount.

items.title: visa, coke, boeing and paypal headline tuesday's earnings
items.summary:
coca-cola, boeing, ups, paypal and s&p global report before the bell, with visa and robinhood after the close.
microsoft, alphabet and amazon follow later in the week, when the ai capex numbers get marked.

items.title: durable goods, consumer confidence and new home sales before the fed
items.summary:
forecasts point to durable goods orders up 0.6% and consumer confidence at 81.2, with new home sales at 651,000 annualised.
the fomc starts its two-day meeting today and is expected to hold rates on wednesday.

items.title: china's industrial profits grow 14.4%, the best in three months
items.summary:
september profits rose 14.4% from a year earlier as ai-related manufacturing and tech exports offset weak domestic demand.
it helped asian equities overnight, with the kospi up 3.8% and the nikkei up 1.7%.

items.title: liverpool 2-0 brighton: an own goal, an isak finish and fourth place
items.summary:
a pascal gross own goal off wirtz's shot and isak's sixth of the season gave liverpool a fourth straight win in all competitions.
the clean sheet lifted them to fourth, two points above chelsea, and it was their first home league win since april.

items.title: xabi alonso brings chelsea to anfield in the league cup on wednesday
items.summary:
it is a carabao cup fourth-round tie at anfield at 20:00 uk on wednesday, alonso's first return since he took the chelsea job in the summer.
arsenal then visit in the league on sunday, so iraola is expected to change most of the side.

meta.next: chelsea (h) carabao cup round 4, wed 28 oct 20:00 uk

items.title: wirtz has a twisted ankle and frimpong is out past the november break
items.summary:
wirtz limped off after 65 minutes against brighton but says the ankle is not serious and he expects to be back for the next game.
szoboszlai is training alone with a hamstring problem, munoz has a knock, and frimpong's new muscle injury rules him out until after the international break.

items.title: araujo's loan is turning into a £47m decision for liverpool
items.summary:
the barcelona loanee has made himself first choice in a defence that had no right-back, and van dijk says he has 'what we need'.
the permanent fee is £47m, and an echo poll and the kop are both pushing the club to pay it.

items.title: chiesa could make his first start of the season against chelsea
items.summary:
with wirtz out and frimpong and munoz sidelined, the echo expects iraola to start chiesa on the right and keep gakpo fresh for arsenal.
mamardashvili is expected in goal after the 3-1 cup win at tottenham, and endo could fill in at right-back.

items.title: liverpool are one of three clubs watching bayern's 18-year-old karl
items.summary:
monday's gossip has arsenal, liverpool and man united monitoring bayern munich's lennart karl, an 18-year-old german midfielder.
the report is a teamtalk round-up rather than a bid, and no fee or contact has been reported.

meta.reliability: teamtalk round-up, no club contact reported

items.title: liverpool tell valencia they will trigger otorbi's £25m clause
items.summary:
liverpool have told valencia they intend to pay the £25m release clause for the winger, according to the club's media watch round-up.
the clause is the only route, so no fee negotiation is expected.
